criteria.notes: The official Podiatry team page has a dedicated Farriers section with multiple current named Farriers.

criteria.criterion_label: Uses or influences the purchase of professional hoof-care products
criteria.notes: A current multi-practitioner Farrier team necessarily uses professional hoof-care products; this is a role-based product-usage conclusion, not a claim of procurement authority.
The official pages describe a worldwide referral center but do not quantify Farrier-team clients.

criteria.criterion_label: Regular appointments and established business activity
criteria.notes: The official hospital and current team pages show an established active Lexington operation.
The hospital is explicitly located in the heart of the Bluegrass in Lexington, Kentucky.
The dedicated Equine Podiatry team is an explicit advanced hoof-care specialisation.
The official team page lists CJF, NZCF and DIPWCF credentials among current team members.

criteria.criterion_label: Works with sport or competition horses
criteria.notes: The retained pages state all breeds and disciplines rather than a specific sport-horse focus.
The official page lists multiple Farriers in the Lexington team.
No named procurement or product-selection decision-maker is identified.

criteria.criterion_label: Strong fit with professional hoof-care products
criteria.notes: A dedicated professional Farrier/Podiatry team has recurring hoof-care product requirements.
The current official site presents active team and hospital operations.

criteria.criterion_label: Apprentice or junior Farrier actively entering the profession
criteria.notes: The retained public evidence does not establish this criterion.
No retained evidence confirms this negative or exclusion criterion.

criteria.criterion_label: No evidence of professional hoof-care activity
criteria.notes: No retained evidence confirms this negative or exclusion criterion.
